description: This file exports various types, functions, and classes related to the context engine system, including types definitions, registry functions, legacy engine support, delegation, and initialization.

methods.name: registerContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a new context engine with the system.

methods.name: getContextEngineFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory for a specific context engine.

methods.name: listContextEngineIds
methods.description: Lists all registered context engine identifiers.

methods.name: resolveContextEngine
methods.description: Resolves and retrieves a specific context engine instance.

methods.name: registerLegacyContextEngine
methods.description: Registers a legacy context engine for compatibility.

methods.name: delegateCompactionToRuntime
methods.description: Delegates data compaction to the runtime engine.

methods.name: ensureContextEnginesInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that all context engines are initialized before use.
